NODE_ENV.description: Enables the production credential checks in env.validation.ts.

PNPM_SKIP_PRUNING.description: Keeps the prisma CLI in the slug so the release phase can run migrate deploy.

PGSSLMODE.description: Heroku Postgres refuses unencrypted connections and DATABASE_URL carries no sslmode, so node-postgres reads this instead. no-verify encrypts without checking the certificate chain, which Heroku's certificates cannot satisfy.

JWT_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Base64-encoded RS256 private PEM. Generate the pair with `pnpm keys:generate`.

JWT_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Base64-encoded RS256 public PEM. The frontend proxy gets this one too.

FRONTEND_URL.description: Public origin of the Next.js app. Sets the CORS allow-list.

COOKIE_DOMAIN.description: Parent domain for the session cookie. The API sets it on api.keyhol.me and proxy.ts reads it on keyhol.me; without a shared parent domain every portal redirects to /login after a successful sign-in.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret for the Stripe webhook endpoint.

SMTP_PORT.description: Outbound SMTP port. 465 selects an implicit TLS connection.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password — the provider API key.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address on a domain verified with the email provider.

SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry DSN. Errors report only while this is set.

SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Fraction of transactions traced, 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.1.

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Twilio account SID. Leave every Twilio value empty to disable SMS.

TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Twilio sender number in E.164 format.

TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_URL.description: Public URL Twilio posts voice status events to.
